name: Kansai International

source.publication: AIP Japan, Civil Aviation Bureau (AIS Japan, https://aisjapan.mlit.go.jp), via the copy at https://nagodede.github.io/aip/japan/
sections: RJBB AD 2.2 ARP, AD 2.12 runway thresholds, AD 2.19 navaids
RJBB AD 2.24 RNAV SID, STAR and transition coding tables with waypoint coordinates and holding
source.notice: Transcribed and simplified for a game. NOT FOR NAVIGATIONAL USE.

units.path: ARINC 424 path terminator: IF initial fix, TF track to fix, DF direct to fix, VA heading to altitude, CA course to altitude, RF radius to fix
units.courseMag/courseTrue: published leg course, degrees magnetic / true
units.magVar: magnetic variation used in the table, degrees (negative = west)
units.min/max: altitude constraint, feet (at or above / at or below; both equal = at)
units.speed: speed limit, knots IAS (maximum unless speedAt or speedAtOrAbove)
units.turn: turn direction onto the leg, L or R
units.navSpec: navigation specification (an RNP value for RNP AR legs)
units.thresholdFt: threshold elevation, feet (displaced threshold where marked)

notes: The AIP copy used is effective 1 MAR 2026, older than the current AIRAC; check AIS Japan before relying on it.
RNAV procedures with coding tables only; conventional procedures (VOR radials, radar vectors) are not included.
Procedures tabled once per runway are merged when their legs are identical; runways lists every runway they serve.
Holds are the RNAV holding patterns from the coding tables (1 min at or below 14000 ft, 1.5 min above).
